reference.scope: UNBC paired IFC only; exact product decimal Tags through RelDefinesByType, duplicate joins excluded.

limitations: Veto counts refer to source owners and product-to-type relationships, not distinct type objects or unique type GUIDs.
A stored-envelope contradiction is a conservative confidence veto, not proof of an incorrect previous IFC identity or improved reference accuracy.
Stored graphics envelopes are not proven API GetOriginalGeometry equivalents under IFC geometry options.
A capped historical-envelope scan has partial coverage; the census includes every retained conflict, not every possible original-geometry conflict.
